summary: Channel strip in one machine, five stages in the classic order: gate, EQ (low cut, low shelf, two bells, high shelf, high cut), compressor, drive, then a clipper and a true-peak limiter at one ceiling. It is built from Neo EQ, Neo Comp, Neo Drive, Neo Clipper and Neo Limiter, so each stage sounds as that machine does with the same settings, and a stage that is off passes the audio untouched (the delay of the whole strip is the same either way, so switching a stage never shifts the track). Use it on a track or a bus when one set of controls is quicker than five machines; Delta hears only what the strip changes.
use_for: A full channel strip in one machine: gate, EQ, compression, drive and limiting.

parameters.name: Gate on
parameters.description: The gate in or out
parameters.how: Switches the gate stage in or out.
parameters.sound: On, quiet noise between sounds is turned down.

parameters.name: Gate threshold
parameters.description: Level (dBFS, the louder channel's peak) the gate opens at; it closes 3 dB lower, after the hold
parameters.how: Sets the level, from -80 to 0 dBFS, at which the gate opens.
parameters.sound: Higher values remove more background noise but can cut into soft notes.

parameters.name: Gate range
parameters.description: How far a closed gate lowers the signal (80: nearly silence)
parameters.how: Sets how far a closed gate turns the signal down, from 0 to 80 dB.
parameters.sound: 80 dB gives near silence between sounds; smaller values leave some of the background.

parameters.name: Gate attack
parameters.description: Time to open
parameters.how: Sets how long the gate takes to open, from 0.1 ms to 50 ms.
parameters.sound: Fast attacks keep hits sharp; slower ones fade them in.

parameters.name: Gate hold
parameters.description: Time the gate stays open after the level falls under the threshold
parameters.how: Sets how long the gate stays open after the level falls under the threshold, from 1 to 500 ms.
parameters.sound: Longer holds stop the gate cutting off note ends.

parameters.name: Gate release
parameters.description: Time to close
parameters.how: Sets how long the gate takes to close, from 10 ms to 2 s.
parameters.sound: Short releases chop tails tightly; long ones let sounds fade out naturally.

parameters.name: EQ on
parameters.description: The EQ stage in or out (a shelf or bell with no gain, and a cut that is off, change nothing)
parameters.how: Switches the whole EQ stage in or out.
parameters.sound: On, the cut, shelves and bells below shape the tone.

parameters.name: Low cut on
parameters.description: The low cut (Butterworth, 12 dB/oct)
parameters.how: Switches the 12 dB per octave low cut in or out.
parameters.sound: On, rumble and low-end mud below the cut frequency are removed.

parameters.name: Low cut freq
parameters.description: Low cut: −3 dB here
parameters.how: Sets the low cut's frequency, from 20 Hz to 20 kHz, where it is 3 dB down.
parameters.sound: Higher values thin the sound by removing more of the low end.

parameters.name: Low shelf freq
parameters.description: Low shelf: half its gain here
parameters.how: Sets the frequency, from 20 Hz to 20 kHz, where the low shelf reaches half its gain.
parameters.sound: It decides how high up the low-end boost or cut reaches.

parameters.name: Low shelf gain
parameters.description: Low shelf gain in 0.1 dB steps
parameters.how: Sets the low shelf's gain from -24 to +24 dB.
parameters.sound: Positive values add weight and warmth; negative values thin out the bass.

parameters.name: Low mid freq
parameters.description: Low-mid bell centre
parameters.how: Sets the low-mid bell's centre frequency, from 20 Hz to 20 kHz.
parameters.sound: It chooses which part of the lower midrange, where mud and body live, you shape.

parameters.name: Low mid gain
parameters.description: Low-mid bell gain in 0.1 dB steps
parameters.how: Sets the low-mid bell's gain from -24 to +24 dB.
parameters.sound: Cutting clears muddiness; boosting adds body.

parameters.name: Low mid Q
parameters.description: Low-mid bell width
parameters.how: Sets the low-mid bell's width: a higher Q is narrower, from 0.1 to 30.
parameters.sound: Narrow values reach one note or resonance; wide values change the broad tone.

parameters.name: High mid freq
parameters.description: High-mid bell centre
parameters.how: Sets the high-mid bell's centre frequency, from 20 Hz to 20 kHz.
parameters.sound: It chooses which part of the upper midrange, where presence and harshness live, you shape.

parameters.name: High mid gain
parameters.description: High-mid bell gain in 0.1 dB steps
parameters.how: Sets the high-mid bell's gain from -24 to +24 dB.
parameters.sound: Boosting adds presence and bite; cutting softens harshness.

parameters.name: High mid Q
parameters.description: High-mid bell width
parameters.how: Sets the high-mid bell's width: a higher Q is narrower, from 0.1 to 30.
parameters.sound: Narrow values reach one harsh spot; wide values change the broad tone.

parameters.name: High shelf freq
parameters.description: High shelf: half its gain here
parameters.how: Sets the frequency, from 20 Hz to 20 kHz, where the high shelf reaches half its gain.
parameters.sound: It decides how far down the top-end boost or cut reaches.

parameters.name: High shelf gain
parameters.description: High shelf gain in 0.1 dB steps
parameters.how: Sets the high shelf's gain from -24 to +24 dB.
parameters.sound: Positive values add air and brightness; negative values darken the sound.

parameters.name: High cut on
parameters.description: The high cut (Butterworth, 12 dB/oct)
parameters.how: Switches the 12 dB per octave high cut in or out.
parameters.sound: On, hiss and harsh highs above the cut frequency are removed.

parameters.name: High cut freq
parameters.description: High cut: −3 dB here
parameters.how: Sets the high cut's frequency, from 20 Hz to 20 kHz, where it is 3 dB down.
parameters.sound: Lower values make the sound duller by removing more of the top end.

parameters.name: Comp on
parameters.description: The compressor in or out
parameters.how: Switches the compressor stage in or out.
parameters.sound: On, the loud parts are turned down and the sound gets more even.

parameters.name: Comp mode
parameters.description: Clean: transparent VCA. Glue: bus VCA. FET: fast feedback. Opto: smooth, program-dependent
parameters.how: Chooses the compressor's character: Clean, Glue, FET or Opto.
parameters.sound: Clean is transparent, Glue binds, FET is punchy and Opto is smooth.

parameters.name: Comp threshold
parameters.description: Level where compression starts
parameters.how: Sets the level, from -60 to 0 dB, above which compression starts.
parameters.sound: Lower values compress more of the signal and sound denser.

parameters.name: Comp ratio
parameters.description: Compression ratio (top: limiting)
parameters.how: Sets how strongly signal above the threshold is reduced, from 1:1 up to 20:1 and limiting.
parameters.sound: Higher ratios flatten the peaks for a more controlled sound.

parameters.name: Comp attack
parameters.description: Time to 63 % of the gain change
parameters.how: Sets how fast the gain falls above the threshold, from 0.05 ms to 200 ms.
parameters.sound: Fast attacks dull the punch; slow ones let hits through.

parameters.name: Comp release
parameters.description: Time back to 37 % of the gain change
parameters.how: Sets how fast the gain recovers, from 5 ms to 3 s.
parameters.sound: Short releases sound lively and can pump; long ones sound smooth.

parameters.name: Comp makeup
parameters.description: Gain after compression
parameters.how: Adds 0 to 24 dB of gain after compression.
parameters.sound: It restores the level lost to compression.

parameters.name: Drive on
parameters.description: The saturation in or out
parameters.how: Switches the saturation stage in or out.
parameters.sound: On, harmonics are added and the sound gets warmer or grittier.

parameters.name: Drive mode
parameters.description: Saturation model
parameters.how: Chooses the saturation model: Tape, Tube, Transistor, Diode or Fold.
parameters.sound: Tape is soft and warm, Tube is rich, Transistor is firm, Diode is edgy and Fold is bright and metallic.

parameters.name: Drive
parameters.description: Gain into the saturation (auto gain holds the level steady)
parameters.how: Raises the level into the saturation by 0 to 36 dB.
parameters.sound: More drive adds more harmonics, from subtle warmth to heavy distortion.

parameters.name: Drive mix
parameters.description: Dry/wet of the saturation
parameters.how: Blends the saturated signal with the dry signal.
parameters.sound: Lower values add the colour as a subtle layer under the original sound.

parameters.name: Clip on
parameters.description: A 4× oversampled hard clipper at the ceiling
parameters.how: Switches the 4x oversampled hard clipper in or out.
parameters.sound: On, peaks are flattened at the ceiling, which makes the sound louder and edgier.

parameters.name: Limit on
parameters.description: The true-peak limiter at the ceiling (after the clipper when both are on)
parameters.how: Switches the true-peak limiter in or out.
parameters.sound: On, nothing passes the ceiling, with the limiter after the clipper.

parameters.name: Ceiling
parameters.description: The clipper's ceiling (dBFS) and the limiter's true-peak ceiling (dBTP); the limiter's range is −12 to 0 dB
parameters.how: Sets the clipper's ceiling from -24 to 0 dBFS and the limiter's true-peak ceiling from -12 to 0 dBTP.
parameters.sound: A lower ceiling cuts the peaks harder and gives a quieter, more squashed top.

parameters.name: Limiter release
parameters.description: Limiter release time
parameters.how: Sets the limiter's recovery time, from 1 ms to 1 s.
parameters.sound: Short releases sound loud and punchy but can distort; long ones sound smooth.

parameters.name: Output
parameters.description: Gain after the strip, 0.1 dB steps (the editor's Match sets it from the gain-match reading)
parameters.how: Adds -24 to +24 dB of gain after the strip.
parameters.sound: It matches the loudness to the untreated sound so you judge the processing fairly.

parameters.name: Delta
parameters.description: Hear only what the strip changes: the output minus the input, delayed to match (glides over 10 ms)
parameters.how: Plays only the difference between the output and the input.
parameters.sound: You hear only what the strip changes, such as the noise removed or the harmonics added.

readings.description: Short-term loudness out − in (K-weighted, 3 s): what Output would have to take back for equal loudness
The gate's gain now (0 open, negative: closed by that much)
The limiter's largest gain reduction in the last 3 s
The strip's latency (the same whichever stages are on), reported to NeoBuzz Live
